sources.title: uniEX — ficha oficial de la serie
sources.scope_note: Familia modular; el diámetro de husillo, la producción y el material cambian según la configuración. Los extremos de la serie no representan un único equipo.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: Series only: diameters 35–90mm, L/D 30, outputs 10–800kg/h. Not used as individual model limits.

sources.title: EVO FFS — datos de la familia
sources.scope_note: Rangos de distintas configuraciones, no una combinación garantizada para una sola línea.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: EVO FFS COMPACT overview: 3–5 layers; die diameters 160–200mm; extruder diameters 50–90mm. Configurable series, not a counted specific machine.

sources.title: Kautex KBB series — technical table with model-specific columns
sources.scope_note: Values from KBB 80 column; mould geometry is not container geometry.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: KBB40/60/80 columns: clamp force 250/300/400kN; clamp stroke 250mm; maximum mould width 610/760/960mm; mould length 430mm.

sources.title: GEISS T11 — datos oficiales de configuración
sources.scope_note: Máquina paramétrica; 1000 × 900 mm es la dimensión nominal mínima configurable, NO la máxima. Borde de sujeción 20 mm perimetral.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: Minimum nominal dimensions 1000×900mm; nominal dimensions describe maximum sheet of an individually configured machine. Clamping rim 20mm all round; standard tool height 620mm, expandable.

sources.title: motan LUXOR HD — LHD 30 / LHD 60 / LHD 150, V021 (2022-10)
sources.scope_note: LHD 150: hot-air surface moisture removal. Nominal hopper is not useful volume; no quantified dew point.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: LHD30/60/150: hopper 30/60/150L; air 25/50/100m³/h; maximum 130°C; heater 1.5/1.5/4.5kW; connected 2/2/5kW. ABS 8/16/39kg/h at 80°C, 2–3h for surface moisture removal.

sources.title: Moiron — M2-I and M2-II manufacturer product specifications
sources.scope_note: M2-I and M2-II are separate models. Use each model block; shot mass is stated for ABS, not melt volume.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: M2-I: Clamping force 15T; Screw diameter 20mm; Injection weight 20g(ABS); Injection pressure 60Mpa. M2-II: 15g(ABS), 100Mpa, 200mm/s.

sources.title: Xihua XH-436 — 20T / 25T technical table
sources.scope_note: Selected 25T column. Paired mould thickness/opening values are ambiguous and remain unavailable; kg/cm² as printed is not silently treated as kgf/cm².
sources.reviewed_excerpt: 20T / 25T columns: screw 22mm; screw stroke 110mm; nozzle stroke 150mm; shot mass 40g with unspecified polymer; pressure printed as kg/cm².

sources.title: Xihua XH-433-45 — technical table
sources.scope_note: Standard published table specifies Ø25 mm, L/D 33:1. Model suffix does not establish screw diameter. Custom options require a separate variant sheet.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: Model XH-433-45; table explicitly says screw diameter 25mm, L/D 33:1, 0-95rpm, motor 4kW, total power 12kW. Do not infer diameter 45mm from name.

sources.title: Xihua XH-434-25 — technical table
sources.scope_note: Standard published table specifies Ø25 mm, L/D 33:1. Model suffix does not establish screw diameter. Custom options require a separate variant sheet.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: XH-434-25; screw 25mm; L/D 33:1; screw 0-95rpm; motor 4kW; total installed power 12kW.

sources.title: COLLIN E Entrance extruders — E 20 E column
sources.scope_note: Concrete E 20 E column. Nominal cylinder diameter is published; do not infer screw clearance. Cylinder lengths 25 D and 30 D are alternative configurations, not a selected L/D. No output or installed power assigned.
sources.reviewed_excerpt: E20E column: nominal cylinder diameter 20mm; dimensions 1330×680×1650mm; torque 140Nm. Cylinder lengths 25D or 30D are alternatives, not a selected geometry.

sources.title: Xihua XH-430B-25 — Technical Parameters
sources.scope_note: Standard model, not custom options. No documented output, die gap, thickness or haul-off speed. Monolayer maximum film diameter is a configuration range, not a specific limit.

sources.title: Xihua XH-430B-25-3 — Technical Parameters

sources.title: COLLIN — Blown Film Lines E Entrance, BL 400 E / BL 600 E technical data
sources.scope_note: Use each individual column. Roller width differs from maximum web width. Extruder, die, output and installed power are not specified for a complete configuration.
